versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00189 For each FlatInstanceDescriptor referencing a ParameterDataPrototype instance of a AtomicSwComponentType ’s SwcInternalBehavior aggregated in the role sharedParameter with the swCalibrationAccess set to readOnly or readWrite an entry in the McSupportData with the role mcParameterInstance shall be created with the following attributes: • symbol set to the C-symbol name used for the allocation • flatMapEntry referencing to the corresponding FlatInstanceDescriptor element of the ParameterDataPrototype
